messages.content: Hi! Northline Care weekly check-in. How's your blood sugar been this week?
Honestly it's been high and I keep forgetting my meds. Are you guys gonna help or what?
Sorry for the slow response. I can help log your meds and readings. What was your highest blood sugar this week?
Like 280, 300. This is stressing me out. Is that bad? What do I do?
I can't advise on medication - those readings need to go to a nurse. I can escalate you, but they're backed up about 31 hours right now. Want me to send it over?
31 HOURS?? For high blood sugar?? I'm done. STOP
Understood. Stopping your check-ins now. Call your clinic or 911 if it's urgent. Sorry this didn't work out.

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
